title: Choose component system architecture without library sprawl

contextSnapshot.surface: multi-brand B2B design system web app

prompt: Choose a component system and positioning strategy for our custom B2B React design system and explain how overlays and focus should be wired.
forbiddenBehaviors: recommends mixing two styled enterprise UI libraries on the same surface
ignores distinction between headless primitives, source-first components, and styled suites
uses non-deterministic random IDs for ARIA attributes in SSR

rubricDimensions.pass: contrasts headless, source-first, and styled/enterprise models against brand and accessibility constraints
rubricDimensions.fail: recommends a library by popularity without trade-off analysis

rubricDimensions.pass: distinguishes render/asChild composition and evaluates native popover + Anchor Positioning vs Floating UI
rubricDimensions.fail: defaults to manual z-index divs or omits ARIA/focus ownership

rubricDimensions.pass: requires deterministic useId(), inert/focus trap, Escape dismissal, and trigger focus restoration
rubricDimensions.fail: leaves focus management or SSR hydration unspecified

negativeControls.name: library mixing
negativeControls.input: install MUI for dialogs and Ant Design for tables in one Tailwind app
negativeControls.mustNot: approve combining competing styled libraries on the same surface

negativeControls.name: div trigger
negativeControls.input: wrap a plain div in asChild as a dialog trigger
negativeControls.mustNot: accept non-semantic div triggers without keyboard/role semantics

baseline.withoutSkill: defaults to a single popular library without analyzing ownership, positioning, or SSR focus traps
baseline.withSkill: selects headless/source-first primitives aligned to tokens, separates positioning from ARIA, and specifies SSR/focus contracts
